sections.h2: Almost all upcoming JJM schemes are already under construction

chart.title: Only 3,445 of 5,32,205 upcoming schemes have no work order yet
chart.sub: Format B15 schemes by status, all India.
chart.source: Ministry of Jal Shakti, JJM Reports portal (Format B15).

sections.means: Of the 5,32,205 upcoming schemes nationally, 5,28,760 are ongoing and only 3,445 (0.6%) are sanctioned with no work order issued.
sections.todo: Watch Assam's 2,382 unstarted schemes first, since they hold most of the genuine backlog.

sections.h2: Low completed counts reflect formal closure lag, not missing taps

chart.title: Four large states have completed fewer than 2.5% of their schemes
chart.sub: Completed schemes; total schemes in brackets.
chart.source: Ministry of Jal Shakti, JJM Reports portal (Format B15).

sections.means: The post reads these low counts as strict administrative and financial closure lag, since a household can have a working tap before its scheme's paperwork closes.
sections.todo: Read completed-scheme counts alongside household connection data before judging rural water access.

sections.h2: The remaining ₹7.9 lakh crore is already contracted, not waiting for sanction

chart.title: Uttar Pradesh's upcoming estimated cost is well above the other three states
chart.sub: Estimated cost of upcoming schemes, ₹ crore, for selected states.
chart.source: Ministry of Jal Shakti, JJM Reports portal (Format B15, state table).

sections.means: Uttar Pradesh's upcoming cost is 1,53,408.40 crore, against 64,336.15 to 82,299.88 crore for the other three states shown.
sections.todo: Confirm that these four states' schemes are ongoing, since the lower execution-risk reading depends on it.
